title: MarketplaceListing
description: Marketplace listing for a pet. Source: docs/EDD.md §4.12; docs/SCHEMA.md §2.8 marketplace_listings. Phase 3 — gated by FF_MARKETPLACE.

id.description: Marketplace listing id (PK). Used as listingId in API requests.

petId.description: Pet being listed. ON DELETE RESTRICT — a listed pet cannot be deleted while an active listing exists.

sellerTokenHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the seller's pet access token used to verify ownership.

priceCredits.description: Asking price in food credits (CHECK price_credits > 0). Min price formula: (pet_level * 100) + (rarity_multiplier * 500).

status.description: Lifecycle status. Only one 'active' listing is allowed per pet (idx_marketplace_listings_active_pet UNIQUE).

listedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the listing was created.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiry timestamp. NULL = no expiry.

completedAt.description: Set when status transitions to 'sold' or 'cancelled'.
